sources.title: KV Cache VRAM Calculator: How Much Memory Does Context Length Need? (2026)
sources.snippet: The KV cache is the memory a transformer uses to remember every token in the context, and its size grows linearly with context length: bytes per token = 2 × layers × KV heads × head dimension × bytes per value. For Qwen3 32B at FP16 that is 256 KiB per token, or about 8 GB for a 32k-token context, on top of the model weights. This is why a model that loads fine can still run out of memory ...
